ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure 1, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle B=80^\circ$, $\angle C=30^\circ$. If $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle ADE$, $\angle DAC=32^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle EAC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given: $\because$ $\angle B=80^\circ$ and $\angle C=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BAC=180^\circ-80^\circ-30^\circ=70^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle ADE$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BAC=\angle DAE=70^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle EAC=\angle DAE-\angle DAC=70^\circ-32^\circ=\boxed{38^\circ}$
